title: Orbi Beach Tower 2+1
description: 2+1 apartment in Orbi Beach Tower. Address: Batumi, 57 Sherif Khimshiashvili St. 32nd floor, 70 m². Sunny side with sea view and Lech and Maria Kaczyński Park. Quality renovation with modern design. Prestigious apart-hotel: first coastline — about 50 m to the sea, reception and 24/7 security. Developed infrastructure: Eclipse casino, G.Garden restaurant, Metro City mall, Carrefour supermarket, cafés, pool, fitness centre, sports and children's playgrounds. Suitable for living and rental. Spacious fully furnished apartment, bright rooms with panoramic windows, sea view from the balcony. Price $200,000 — confirm current price and deal terms with your manager.
